description: **Hand-written descriptions on generated pages are never overwritten.** `selfdoc gen` now decides whether to reseed a description by classifying the text itself, so a description you rewrote by hand survives regeneration even if a stale `seeded: true` marker was left behind.

**Hand-described generated pages get full stale-description protection.** The STALE001/DRIFT001 exemption now applies only to pages whose description is genuinely machine-generated, so a generated page you have described by hand is checked for staleness like any other page.
